services.name: High-End Video & Content Production
services.title: Automotive Video Production Company in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
services.metaDescription: Cinematic car videos, launch reels, brand films and YouTube series for automotive brands in Riyadh and across the GCC. See our work and send a brief.
services.cardText: Cinematic reels, brand films, influencer videos, and campaign visuals tailored for the automotive industry.
services.answer: BX Media Automotive is a Riyadh-based production company that specialises in video for the automotive industry: vehicle launch reels, brand films, long-form YouTube episodes, event coverage and social cutdowns for car brands, dealerships, detailing studios and motorsport organisers across Saudi Arabia and the GCC.
includes: Vehicle launch films and reels
Hero films and vertical reels for new model reveals, built to run across Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube.
Brand and campaign films
Story-led films for distributors, dealer groups and automotive service brands.
Long-form YouTube production
Multi-episode series and event coverage, such as our nine-episode SAMF motorsport series with ArabGT.
Product and service showcases
Detailing, paint protection and service-centre reels that show the work up close.
Event and motorsport coverage
On-location crews for championships, rallies, track days and launch events.
Social cutdowns
Shoots are repurposed into platform-specific edits so one production feeds more of your channels.
process: Brief
Share your model, audience, launch date and channels. We reply within 24 hours.
Concept and storyboard
We plan shots, locations, talent and deliverables around your goal.
Production
Cinematography built around the vehicle: motion, detail and sound.
Post-production
Edit, colour, sound design and platform-ready cutdowns.
faqs: What kinds of automotive videos does BX Media produce?
Launch reels, brand films, long-form YouTube episodes, influencer videos, event and motorsport coverage, and detailing or service showcases. We specialise in the automotive industry.
Where does BX Media film?
BX Media is based in Riyadh and films across Saudi Arabia, including past shoots in AlUla, Umluj, Jeddah, Taif, Al Baha, Al-Ahsa, Qassim and Hail. We serve clients across the GCC.
How much does an automotive video cost?
It depends on the number of deliverables, shoot days, locations and talent. Send a short brief or a WhatsApp message and we will reply within 24 hours with a tailored content roadmap.

Plan

Automotive businesses: car brands and distributors, dealerships, detailing and paint protection studios, service centres and automotive product brands.

faqs: What is BX Media Automotive?

BX Media Automotive (BX Media) is an automotive content and video production agency based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. It produces cinematic videos, social media content and influencer campaigns specialised for the automotive industry and serves clients across the GCC.
What services does BX Media offer?
Three core services: high-end automotive video and content production, social media account management for automotive brands, and automotive influencer marketing.
Who does BX Media work with?

Car brands and distributors, dealerships, detailing and service centres, automotive product brands, and motorsport and event organisers. Clients include Toyota, Abdul Latif Jameel, BYD, Lotus, Volvo, ArabGT, SAMF and Feynlab.
Does BX Media work outside Riyadh?
Yes. BX Media is based in Riyadh, films across Saudi Arabia and serves clients across the GCC.
How do I start a project with BX Media?
Send a brief through the project intake form or message us on WhatsApp at +966 55 796 9551. We respond within 24 hours with a tailored content roadmap.
